marks.gloss_en: extend kicha/kicha from Ephron's field: as a field is acquired by symbolic exchange, so a woman should be acquired by symbolic exchange
per Rav Huna, the count comes to exclude chalifin (symbolic exchange)
chalifin are effective with an item worth less than a peruta, and a woman does not make herself acquired for less than a peruta
the count 'three' in the reisha comes to exclude chuppah (it does not effect betrothal)
